scope.description: Exact installed InspectorChatPicker, seven verbatim installed functions and exact installed picker CSS in a controlled nested ToolCallTree-style DOM, file URL in separate installed Chrome. Additional original Log pick and forward-target functions run separately in a bounded Node VM.

protected.policy: Never signal, restart, navigate, read profile, or mutate. No operation in this runner targets these processes, port, or profiles.

scope.dependencies: Node >=24 built-ins, installed Chrome executable; no dependency install, builds, Go tests, model calls, application server, or external fetch.
scope.input: CDP Input.dispatchMouseEvent and Input.dispatchKeyEvent only. No DOM dispatchEvent or direct picker event-handler calls.
scope.network: The runner connects only to the allocated 127.0.0.1 CDP endpoint. Fixture CSP denies network; page Network.setBlockedURLs blocks HTTP(S)/WS(S). Chrome background networking is disabled and DNS resolution is blocked.

attempts.policy: Each invocation uses a new evidence/fixture/profile runId and runs each case once. Failed attempts remain under their original runId. No passing run is repeated.

limitations: Controlled DOM reproduces original ToolCallTree wrapper containment, not full app, live data, original GUI, React rendering, or Electron Chromium.

Seven functions, POINTER_ACTIONS, picker class and exact picker CSS execute in Chrome. Original Log pick method and forward-target functions execute separately in Node VM with fixture source state; full SessionLogModel integration is outside scope.
Original Log reverse pick only prioritizes exact tool/call. Nested PTC-start rows fall back to owning root anchor; no child PTC reverse-selection semantics are added.
Shift-wheel, touch, platform menus, window-blur and live application lifecycle are outside this nested-call evidence scope.

installedTree.fixtureRelationship: callRow div contains own toolview plus children; data-subcalls recursively contains ToolCallBranch wrappers. Layout/theme are fixture-only.

cleanup.target: Only own spawned Chrome and verified own CDP process IDs/profile/port
